package domain_test

import (
	"testing"
	"time"

	"github.com/stretchr/testify/require"

	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-teacher-agent/internal/domain"
)

func TestNewDialogTeacherRequestDerivesTeacherJobCausation(t *testing.T) {
	request := domain.DialogTeacherRequest{
		SchemaVersion: 2, EventID: "11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111", DialogID: "22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222",
		EventSequence: 4, TeacherTurnSequence: 1, SourceMessageID: "33333333-3333-4333-8333-333333333333", SourceSequence: 2,
		CanonicalStudentMessageID: "33333333-3333-4333-8333-333333333333", CorrelationID: "33333333-3333-4333-8333-333333333333",
		DialogCausationID: "33333333-3333-4333-8333-333333333333", StudentID: "44444444-4444-4444-8444-444444444444",
		PersonalTeacherID: "55555555-5555-4555-8555-555555555555", ContextType: domain.LearningContextGeneral,
		SourceChannel: domain.DialogMessageChannelWeb, OccurredAt: time.Date(2026, 9, 9, 10, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC),
	}

	normalized, err := domain.NewDialogTeacherRequest(request)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	require.Equal(t, request.DialogCausationID, normalized.DialogCausationID)
	require.Equal(t, request.EventID, normalized.CausationID)
}

func TestNewDialogTeacherRequestRejectsDialogCausationDrift(t *testing.T) {
	request := domain.DialogTeacherRequest{
		SchemaVersion: 2, EventID: "11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111", DialogID: "22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222",
		EventSequence: 4, TeacherTurnSequence: 1, SourceMessageID: "33333333-3333-4333-8333-333333333333", SourceSequence: 2,
		CanonicalStudentMessageID: "33333333-3333-4333-8333-333333333333", CorrelationID: "33333333-3333-4333-8333-333333333333",
		DialogCausationID: "66666666-6666-4666-8666-666666666666", StudentID: "44444444-4444-4444-8444-444444444444",
		PersonalTeacherID: "55555555-5555-4555-8555-555555555555", ContextType: domain.LearningContextGeneral,
		SourceChannel: domain.DialogMessageChannelWeb, OccurredAt: time.Date(2026, 9, 9, 10, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC),
	}

	_, err := domain.NewDialogTeacherRequest(request)
	require.ErrorIs(t, err, domain.ErrInvalidDialogContext)
}
